title: Chapter 258: Unwanted Guests
html:
Changing room? Costumes?

Chen Ge reread the information on the phone, surprised by the new feature.

I understand letting visitors choose a role to deepen their immersion, but what does this one-percent chance of triggering an extreme experience mean?

He would have to witness it in action to understand. After all, he had grasped the Midnight Ticket Counter’s true purpose only after Fan Yu appeared.

Based on past experience, rewards from the black phone should be safe, but caution won’t hurt.After a moment’s thought, Chen Ge reached a decision. I’ll restrict access. Anyone using the changing room will pay an extra twenty as a costume rental fee.

Timid visitors were unlikely to pay extra for more terror. The Ghost’s Changing Room was aimed at Haunted House veterans, who found greater authenticity more enjoyable. Guided by the black phone, Chen Ge went beneath the first-floor staircase, where a small partitioned room had appeared outside the Night of the Living Dead scenario.

Murder by Midnight already occupies part of Night of the Living Dead, and the changing room has reduced it even further. I’ll need to reorganize the layout soon.

Inside the cubicle were two doors marked with male and female symbols. Chen Ge opened one and found rows of costumes hanging from the walls. Unlike ordinary rental clothes, every garment was bloodstained, and many were torn or badly wrinkled. Their condition made it easy to imagine what their former owners had endured.

I guess I understand why this place is called the Ghost’s Changing Room.

The garments had likely belonged to the ghosts’ and monsters’ actual victims. Wearing them would immerse visitors in the despair those victims had once felt.

They choose an identity, then challenge scenarios of increasing difficulty. The first person to clear them all wins the 200,000 reward. This system should keep people interested for a long time.

Chen Ge left the changing room and opened the second message on the black phone.

“New two-star scenario unlocked: Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy. The phone interface allows you to control the props within the scenario freely!”

It failed to unlock before because the Haunted House hadn’t expanded enough. Apparently, each expansion only makes room for three new scenarios.

Chen Ge removed the boards covering the path to the parking garage and followed the black phone’s directions deep into Mu Yang High School. Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy now stood beside it. Though slightly smaller than Mu Yang High School, it contained more intersections and turns, enough to qualify as a small maze.

Two two-star scenarios and a one-star scenario already occupy almost half the garage. How large will the completed four-star School of the Afterlife be?

Chen Ge shook his head. This was not yet the time to worry about that. One step at a time.

To make certain the new scenario posed no safety risks, he entered Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy alone. It contained two separate scenes: The Hanging One and The Stench.

With the recorder and ballpoint pen, Chen Ge cleared the scenario in five minutes beneath the fascinated stares of its mannequins. He emerged wearing a peculiar expression. Two genuine spirits inhabited the scenario, but something had reduced them to such weakness that they were close to vanishing.

Strangest of all, the moment they sensed Chen Ge enter, they fled and hid as though something terrifying were hunting them. He spent four of the five minutes searching for them. When he finally succeeded, he found that neither qualified as a Baleful Specter; both had already been thoroughly subdued.

As long as they’re not dangerous.

Chen Ge returned to the first floor and waited until 8:55 a.m. before opening the Haunted House gates. Sunlight spilled across the entrance, a huge banner hung several meters away, and park employees waited beneath the rest tent. Everything was ready.

Though it was not a holiday, a long line had already formed outside the park. At nine sharp, the gates opened and visitors surged toward the Haunted House in numbers several times greater than usual. The 200,000 reward, the park’s aggressive promotion, Chen Ge’s livestreams and videos, and enthusiastic word of mouth had finally produced results.

“Boss, are all these people here for our Haunted House?” Standing beside Chen Ge, Xu Wan could hardly believe her eyes.

“Of course, and this is only the beginning. Even more people will come in the future.” Chen Ge’s hands trembled; he was even more excited than Xu Wan. “Quick, put on your makeup. It’s time to work!”

Xu Wan managed Minghun while Gu Feiyu ran Murder by Midnight. Uncle Xu helped sell tickets outside, and Chen Ge oversaw the entire operation.

“Anyone who has completed Murder by Midnight and Minghun, please gather here! Scarier and more exciting scenarios await you!”

Some visitors quit immediately after a one-star scenario, but the braver among them chose to attempt a two-star challenge. Several had visited days earlier and formed a group chat to exchange strategies for clearing the Haunted House.

“No need to rush. Please wait beneath the rest tent. We’ll open the scenario once we have a team of ten!”

Because Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy connected to Mu Yang High School, the combined space could accommodate ten visitors at once. Uncle Xu pushed through the crowd to find Chen Ge. Director Luo had called to say that reporters would arrive to promote the park, and he wanted Chen Ge to look after them.

Chen Ge had not realized Director Luo possessed such influence, but he naturally welcomed the publicity. Visitors streamed from the Haunted House. Some had surrendered halfway through, while others forced themselves to finish and emerged on trembling legs. A few simply collapsed in the sunlight and refused to move.

Roughly one visitor in four survived a one-star scenario and chose to attempt the two-star challenges.

After twenty minutes, only seven people had volunteered for the two-star scenarios. Chen Ge decided to make an exception and send the smaller group underground.

As his gaze passed over the seven visitors, it stopped on the last man. The visitor looked perfectly ordinary, yet Chen Ge knew he had seen him before. Then he remembered—the man had appeared beside No. 5 in the surveillance image from Hai Ming Apartments.
